title: AISE capture upload request (v1.0)
description: Upload request semantics for synchronizing one logical capture asset. The client generates one idempotency key per logical upload and reuses it across retries; the server treats a retry carrying the same key and the same content hash as the same logical upload (outcome DUPLICATE), never as a second asset (requirements AC-012). A retry carrying the same key with a different content hash is rejected as IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (see sync-error.schema.json). v1.0 defines single-shot transfers; resumable multi-part transfer is reserved for AISE-006 via the optional part object.

idempotencyKey.title: Client-generated key, stable across retries of one logical upload

contentHash.title: SHA-256 of the exact payload bytes being transferred

part.title: Multi-part transfer descriptor (reserved for AISE-006; omit for single-shot)
